notes: P3 has two views 59–73 years apart. #14: the date field says 1826 but the file name says 1840, so it is labeled 1826–40; its description wrongly names Vevey, but the picture is clearly Bonn and it is in the Stadtmuseum Bonn. #7/#8 (Werner and Ringlin, ‘about 1700’) skipped: both worked in the 1730s–50s, so the date is doubtful. #1, #2, #4 are book spreads of the same plate as #5. #10 (Constantijn Huygens, 1673) is a drawing made in the siege camp, with the town small in the distance.
